book.name: 2 Akakolintu
book.title: Baluwa jhubhele jha Pauli kwa Akakolintu

content: Bhahe, nintyangii jhe kabhele na kumpeke ungolongondi.
Nhwalo anda ninkoliche ungolongondi mangota, ghane ngohe nanhanganicha nenga? Bho, bhabhalabhala jhe bhubhambii ungolongondi?

Ndi kwa nhwalo nikanyandikile, nikapahi jhe kuhika kwino na kukolechwa na ungolongondi na mangota bhimipalwa kuhanganichwa. Nimanya chakaka nenga anda nihanganile, helahela mangota mabhoha nauhangana.
Nikanyandikile pa kutumbula nikibha ngolongondi mumwojho gwango kongo mbihita mahole chwii, nikapahii jhe mme na ungolongondi nambo kuntenda mangota umanye chinimpahi hake.
Kunnekekeya mundo jhuna uhakaho
Mundo jhojhoha ankolecha ungolongondi jhonge, ankolichii jhe ungolongondi nenga kanjika, kwa namuna ankoliche ungolongondi mabhoha, nilonge naha ikoto kubhonekena kubhehe ghanganandela hake.
Luhadabulo lwahadabwilwe mundo jwenio na bhando twe lwakolite.
Ngohe ipalwa mangota munnekeke ulemo gwake, na mumpepeche akoto kubhehe muungolongondi, na akoto kuhengeleka mwojho.
Yene nipembelekeya, munnangiye mundo jwenio kubhehe mupahile hake.
Nikannyandikile baluwa jhela kwa nhwalo gwa kumanya anda mihotola kunyokanikiya mukila kilebhe chinilongela.
Anda munnekekiye mundo jwenio uhakaho gwake, na nenga hele ninnekekeya uhakaho gwake. Nhwalo anda ninnekekiye mundo uhakaho gwake, ninnekekekiye palonge jha Kilichitu kwa nhwalo gwino,
kumpe jhe ndela Limbembela jha kutukolowa, nhwalo tumanye chapala kuhenga.
Pauli iwachii kutama mu kilambo cha ku Toloya
Ngohe puhikita ku Tiloya kwatangachii bhando Malobhe gha Mbone gha Kilichitu, Bhambo akambekii pwache jha kuhenga lihengo lyake.
Nambo nikibha ngolongondi hake kumwojho gwango nhwalo nikankolindeka nnongo gwango Titu. Yene nyakwatabhuka bhando na kujhenda ku Makedoniya.
Kuhoto kwa kutangatilwa na Kilichitu
Nambo tunchenguu Chapanga jwatutenda tuhululutile uhotolo machiko ghoha na Kilichitu. Jwenio atutenda tupechengane malobhe gha chakaka gha Kilichitu kila chehemo ngita luhumba lwa mbone.
Nhwalo twenga tulandana ngita luhumba lwambone lwa ubane lulupehitwe na Yecho Kilichitu kwa Chapanga, luhumba lwa mbone lulwahikila bhando bhoha bhibhakombolilwe na bhibhahobholela.
Kwa bhala bhubhahobholela, luhumba lono luleta kuwegha, nambo kwa bhala bhibhakombolilwe, luhumba lono ndi lwambone luleta ughome. Bho, ndi ghane jwahoto kuhenga lihengo lende?

Twenga ngita bhando bhange jhe bhibhachulucha Malobhe gha Chapanga kupata mbijha. Nambo kwa kulombana na Kilichitu twenga ndi bhando bhituhobholeka palonge jha Chapanga, anda bhando bhitutumitwe na Chapanga.
